name: Park Ji-hoon
bio:
Park Ji-hoon's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his compulsory military service, where he maintained vehicle engines. This ignited a passion for precision and efficiency, leading him to pursue mechanical engineering after his discharge. He specialized in aerodynamics, driven by a fascination with the forces shaping vehicle performance. Park joined Team WRT after several years at Hyundai's R&D center, eager to apply his expertise in a racing environment.

As a wind tunnel operator, Park is known for his meticulous data analysis and his ability to translate complex aerodynamic principles into practical solutions. He emphasizes a data-driven approach, ensuring every adjustment is validated by empirical evidence. His colleagues respect his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to identify subtle improvements that can make a significant difference on the track. Park's dedication extends beyond the tunnel; he mentors junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning within the team.

What truly sets Park apart is his ability to connect seemingly disparate data points, spotting patterns others might miss. This, combined with his pragmatic mindset, makes him invaluable in optimizing aerodynamic performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave on the left side.
physical.description: Park is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning his workstation at the end of each day, regardless of how busy he is.
